title: Listening Drill — Reservoir walk
description: Visitor briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Reservoir walk
sections.transcript:
GUIDE: Welcome to our visit to the old reservoir. Before we leave, make sure your name appears on the list I'm holding. If you can't see your name, speak to me privately rather than adding it yourself.

GUIDE: Our meeting point is the stone bridge. The visit itself will last eighty minutes. You don't need to take anything heavy, but please bring a water bottle.

GUIDE: We'll finish at the viewing platform. From there you can make your own way home. One last detail: the footpath is narrow in places. If you're separated from the group, phone the number printed on your ticket rather than taking a shortcut.
